title: God's Purpose for Suffering
definition: God's purpose for suffering teaches that God can use trials to refine faith, deepen dependence, produce endurance, and display His grace.
summary: Suffering is painful and often confusing, but it is not meaningless in God's hands.
christFocus: Christ entered suffering, redeemed through suffering, and comforts His people in suffering.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Suffering is painful and often confusing, but it is not meaningless in God's hands.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
